title: PayCode Decoder — ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, ACH, FedNow
description: Paste any payment code for instant plain-English explanations, MT↔MX mappings, flow diagrams, and test XML. Covers ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, ACH R-codes, FedNow, SEPA, UETR, IBAN. No API. No PII. Works offline.
